community.name: Ulukhaktok
community.institution: This dashboard is provided by the Alfred Wegener Institute Helmholtz Centre for Polar and Marine Research.

marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind east 40 knots diminishing to east 30 early this afternoon
and to east 20 early this evening. Wind diminishing to light Sunday
morning. Scattered flurries ending near midnight. Blowing snow
ending early this evening. Visibility 1 mile or less in blowing
snow. Temperatures near minus 3. Outside the ice edge freezing spray ending this
evening. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Outside the ice edge seas 2 to 3 metres subsiding to 1 to 2 late
this evening and to 1 or less Sunday afternoon.<br/>

marine.title: Extended Forecast
marine.text:
Monday: Wind light becoming south 15 knots in the
 morning.<br/>Tuesday: Wind southeast 15 to 20 knots increasing to
 southeast 25 to 30 late in the day.<br/>Wednesday: Wind southeast 25 to 30 knots diminishing to
 east 10 to 15.<br/>
